name: Atlantic Acquisition Corp I
summary: Atlantic Acquisition Corp I focuses on effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was formerly known as JAB Acquisition Corp I and changed its name to Atlantic Acquisition Corp I in November 2026. The company was incorporated in 2026 and is based in Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey.
